title: Grilled Aubergine Skewers with French Flair
description: A simple yet elegant French-inspired recipe featuring roasted aubergine skewers, perfect for a light summer meal.
instructions: 2. Cut aubergines into 1-inch pieces and place in a bowl.
3. Drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
4. Thread aubergine pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until aubergines are tender.
6. Meanwhile, combine garlic, balsamic vinegar, and roasted red peppers in a small bowl.
7. Brush skewers with garlic-balsamic mixture during last 2 minutes of grilling.
8. Serve hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
